executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and Enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-09-01 reviewed eight relevant reports; it does not indicate any confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
